fixed_signal.credit_premium: corporate1year YTM minus same-date government1year YTM, percentage points
fixed_signal.condition: Select only when current quarter-end month's premium strictly exceeds the median of the preceding12consecutive calendar-month premiums, excluding the current month. Even median averages the middle two. Equality means known cash.
fixed_signal.missing: Any of the13required months missing yields unknown/cash; retain the interval in all denominators and the unconditional comparator.
